core_obligations: Verify properness of every condition to confine the argument to proper maps.

Closed subscheme of P^n is relative Proj of a quotient graded algebra.

difficulty_reason: For S with an ample invertible sheaf and f : X -> S, the lemma lists eight equivalent conditions: projective, H-projective, quasi-projective plus proper, H-quasi-projective plus proper, proper with X carrying an ample line bundle, proper with an f-ample line bundle, proper with an f-very ample line bundle, and presentation as relative Proj of a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra generated in degree one by a finite type module. The retained proof is fully written: it first notes all conditions imply properness so the argument lives in the proper world, chains the Morphisms-chapter equivalences (projective-is-quasi-projective-proper, H-projective, projective-over-quasi-projective-is-H-projective), notes (1) implies (7) immediately from the definitions and (3)-(6) equivalence from the definition of quasi-projective, imports the just-collected quasi-projective five-way equivalence (lemma-quasi-projective, card L16072) to fuse (3), (5), (7), and constructs (8) from (2) by writing P^n_S as relative Proj of a polynomial algebra (Constructions, lemma-projective-space-bundle), realizing X as relative Proj of a graded quotient algebra via Divisors, lemma-closed-subscheme-proj, and checking the generation hypotheses; the converse is Divisors, lemma-relative-proj-projective. Retained author proof at lines 14047-14100.

dedup.scope: The eight-way projective equivalence, distinct from the five-way quasi-projective equivalence collected as L16072.
